components.name: Gion Machiya Heritage Boutique Hotel (Check-in)
components.description: Restored 120-year-old traditional cedar townhouse with modern acoustic insulation and private rock garden.

components.name: Scenic Sagano Romantic Scenic Railway
components.description: Open-air vintage diesel locomotive tracing the Hozugawa River ravine during peak foliage.

components.name: Hozugawa Traditional River Boat Descent
components.description: 16km river navigation steered with bamboo poles through roaring gorges and tranquil pools.

components.name: Riverside Kaiseki Lunch at Arashiyama Waterfront
components.description: Handmade yudofu tofu tasting menu overlooking the mist rising over Mount Ogura.

components.name: Private Tenryu-ji Sogenchi Garden Meditation Session
components.description: Early-morning entrance before general gates open. Guided breathwork and historic iconography lecture.

components.name: Alpine Panoramic Chalet & Spa (Check-in)
components.description: Direct views of the North Face of the Eiger with Finnish outdoor heated thermal pools.

components.name: Eiger Express Tricable Gondola Flight
components.description: High-speed 3S cableway climbing 1,400 meters in 15 minutes straight to the Eiger Glacier station.

components.name: Jungfraujoch Top of Europe & Ice Palace Discovery
components.description: Highest railway station in Europe at 3,454m with guided glacier walking and Ice Palace tunnel.
